title: A part number stocked only at another location does not block the create here
custom_preconds:
• Two locations, A and B. Part X is stocked at B only.
  • Signed in at location A.
custom_steps:
1. New Inventory Part with Part Number X (same case), a description, Category and Cost; Save.
  2. Switch to location B and search X.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • The part saves at A (it may link to X's Part Library entry); no "already exists at this location" refusal.

Step 2:

  • B still has its own X, unchanged.
